title: Default switch
answer: With storage=None, the environment selects dense/packed if set; otherwise the shipped choice is packed. Eligible CUDA fp32 4-bit D64/D128 K becomes PackedSpKeys, packed_prepare/append creates TQ4 codes and norms, and attention uses spq1 rotate/bulk (bulk_shared at G4/8), spo2/spo4 ordered selection, and spo2 merge under the packed table. Two-bit or missing-backend defaults fall back to dense with a reason; explicit ineligible packed raises. Dense opt-out keeps the dense quantizer and native epsilon/split-K path/table. The dense wrapper body is byte-identical (574 bytes). Old four-bit callers now receive an owned object, need packed margins, get a prefill refusal, and raw dense entries reject that object. Diagnostics still return output/mask. Identity/generation/revision and bounded append checks work under the documented unchanged-prefix contract, but the factory cannot reserve growth (F09), native capacity can narrow (F04), and the table pin is bypassable at use (F01). On identical bulk scores, margins and partition width, no default packed selection rule skips a key selected by dense: both use inclusive prefix max and >=. L=1 causal exposes all S keys; sinks do not enter selection. Read apa_sp2.py:61-136, apa_packed.py:88-146,215-437, packed_launcher.cuh:14-55, launcher.cuh:169-245, parallel.cuh:90-106 and apa_sp1_1.cuh:56-73; ran receipts 016,036,039,045.

The source census has 43 vector-cast lines: 21 uint4, 8 uint2, 11 float4, three float2, zero int4/int2; this includes stores and two mutant branches. General scalar alignment of an arbitrary external DLPack base is also an inherited unguarded precondition; checking byte_offset alone does not establish base alignment. The table states baseline behavior for every refusal class. Read all casts and launchers, core.h:103-138 and bindings.cpp:1177-1212; ran receipts 009-015,034,038,045-047 and retained LF3/4 checks.

title: Non-finite values
answer: Full dense parity does not hold. NaN q/k/v row propagation is repaired at all three named merges; the retained LF2 NaN cases agree in row sets. TQ4 +/-Inf keys can yield -Inf bulk and finite output where dense is non-finite: r2_tq4, tc_tq4, EB2b, EB3 and EB4 (F02; public fp32 r2 included). INT4 r2/tc instead carry NaN scales and can be non-finite where dense is finite. Constructed +/-Inf queries with opposite-sign finite keys give dense zero versus packed NaN; the ordered D1/r2 and TC/EB normalizers likewise can differ on all -Inf logits. NaN/+Inf sinks add another dense-zero/packed-NaN case (F06; EB2b has no sink argument). Zero-norm keys stay finite: TQ4 norm is zero, INT4 zero codes use safe scale one. The V quantizer intentionally poisons an entire low-precision token, so finite column sets differ although the row remains non-finite; blind F03 was withdrawn under F1's explicit row contract. Read packed.cuh:14-23,36-99,148-188, eb2b.cuh:8-27, eb2b_values.cuh:12-48, merge.cuh:14-30, kernels.cu:2172-2195; ran host receipts 016,039,048/050 and audited LF2/LF2S in 031-032. Negative-Inf and value-Inf device cases are staged, not run; exact receipt row differences are below.

title: Tickets, hooks and streams
answer: Per-device ownership and normal reset are sound under the single legacy-default-stream contract: CheckedDeviceGuard selects q's device, the recursive mutex covers growth/enqueue, new slots are zeroed, and the last atomicInc wraps at NC-1. A rejected launch that starts no CTA takes no ticket; a sticky execution fault does not promise context recovery. The hook timeout synchronizes then resets merge slots before throwing; both EB3/EB4 pass that pointer/count. The choose kernel has completed beforehand, or choose tickets are absent in default CHOOSE_SITE=1. Retained FH LF5 has 11 successful checks; its same-process next-output bytes are not retained, so that particular fresh-process equality is receipt-only. Build F has 99 dynamic exports, zero hook-symbol matches, no device EarlyCounterHook signatures, 13 real spo2 entries and no hook/timeout strings. FH has 34 device hook signatures and two hook methods among 15 entries. Ordinary nm reports stripped host symbols, so it cannot establish hidden bridge symbols. All launches use stream 0; Python exposes no alternate stream. Unsupported concurrent external/non-default streams may race; they are out of contract. Actual nvcc -E --default-stream per-thread fails at the new #error; legacy preprocessing succeeds. Read eb3.cuh:91-164,568-607,811-869,944-947,1102 and eb4.cuh:207-218,719-720,824; ran 024,027,028,033,035.

RTLD_NOLOAD|LAZY probes the already-loaded _C library; Linux fallback dlopen and symbol lookup are valid here. answer: Independent streaming comparison of sha-checked B/F dumps found B=778 functions, F=781: 750 equal, 28 changed, zero removed, three added, exactly the stored substantive counts. The changed groups are 18 EB3 fused selects, six EB4 mixed selects, three spo2 merges and one EB2b quantizer; additions are three spq1::pack_int4_rows types. The six retained spq6 bulk variants (D64/D128 x V0/1/3) cannot be reached through a supported default-build dispatch: var is fixed to 2 and non-default environment values refuse before rotation; all other launch sites explicitly use V2. Their presence is not itself a product defect. Original G7 still FAILS because its six registered removals did not occur; the attempt-specific override passes a different predicate. Read spq6.cuh:222-276, CMakeLists.txt:77-81 and every bulk_mma_tq launch; ran 020,023,024,041,045. See SASS_AUDIT.json for every exact name/body hash.

title: Determinism and numerics
answer: Source reasoning supports bitwise repeatability for valid, unchanged inputs on one device under the default-stream contract: output writes are disjoint; integer tickets select the last CTA but do not set summation order; merges visit chunks in fixed ascending order; no floating-point atomics are used. This CPU-only review did not measure run-to-run GPU output. I independently inventoried 6,922 retained B/F LF1 arrays and, after excluding one combined timing/byte-census structure, rechecked 6,921 using dtype/shape checks, informative same-width unsigned views, and np.array_equal: all equal. That is finite-case evidence, not universal determinism. The receipt uses one build per side and the engine's default logical CUDA device; it does not record a physical GPU UUID/model, so that identity cannot be independently reconstructed. For finite nonnegative denominators, >0 and !=0 give identical results, including +/-0 behavior; finite operands alone can overflow and change B's finite zero into F's NaN (F06). Read merge.cuh:14-30 and EB3/4 fused merge chains/tickets; ran 023,028,035,037,039,041. No model-quality or hardware-portability claim follows.

title: Tests and evidence
answer: Both requested CPU suites pass: 40 policy IDs and 15 F1 IDs (55 total), recomputed from the verbose log. They cover policy/forwarding, identity, loader and macro checks, mainly with fakes. Existing GPU receipts cover registered finite identity, 32 vector-refusal IDs plus six controls, 63 refusal/knob checks and 11 FH timeout/knob checks. I recomputed 6,921 array identities from 6,922 retained arrays (one timing structure excluded), 44 regression files/2,078 IDs and 729 CPU regression IDs; outcomes match their before arms, including 36 GPU failures/15 errors and 125 CPU failures/15 errors, not an all-green suite. LF2 remains FAIL: 246/260 checks true, including two failed L19 controls and 12 Inf predictions; supplementary LF2S has 17/26 true and is PASS only because its nine Inf misses are predictions. Missing coverage includes pin bypass, reserved factory growth and large capacities, raw empty helpers, EB3 timeline at G3/5/6/7/8, -Inf and V Inf, all -Inf logits, finite overflow/non-finite sinks, and column-level non-finite behavior. These lines do not re-establish ticket growth, multiple devices, alternate streams or repeatability; no physical-device UUID is recorded. Read both entire CPU test files and scripts/apa_p1f1_gpu.py LF1-LF6; ran 021-022,025,029-032,035-037,041,043. Full gap matrix and all exit/log hashes follow.

title: Other inherited behavior
answer: No additional BLOCKER was found. The default factory's append limit (F09), stale native declaration (F07), and evidence provenance/count NIT (F08) need disposition. Packed prefill refusal is the registered temporary limitation, not an accidental fallback; G=1 misaligned K/V refusal is a safe implementation limit. General ambient-device assumptions and scalar alignment of arbitrary external DLPack bases are inherited engine preconditions, not fixed here. The original SASS removal gate remains failed and is not relabeled as passing. No product source was edited, no build or GPU run was performed, and no file was deleted. Read all 17 diff files and their called mechanisms; 044 confirms an empty product working diff. Pending lead GPU reproductions are supportive checks, not substitutes for the source arguments.
